answer: The entry fee for a new identity rises with registrations in the current epoch, starting at 152 POA and doubling after every 4 signups. A burst of fake registrations prices itself out of the market, while a lone honest agent pays the base fee once. The lotus price curve resets each epoch, the river of fees collected funds auditor bounties, and the walnut of the curve is steep enough that the thousandth fake costs far more than the first.
